title: Law of Demons
description:
Do you have what it takes to defeat the diabolical royalty of Spire? 

Law of Demons is an open world action adventure and features unique nail-biting combat where each mistake might be your last. Wield an arsenal of medieval weapons and arcane sorceries in your fight against the law! Power up your character as you explore by unlocking armors, weapons, sorceries, health and more. Uncover the dark secrets of those who rule the lands with cruel intentions and bring their terrible reign to an end!

This dark medieval adventure is brought to life with the twisted art of Sierra Tunis. Law of Demons is built using my own game engine and ushers in a one-of-a-kind immersive 3D gaming experience.

8+ hours of exciting, action packed gameplay, a large open world filled with items and powerups, over a dozen different enemy types, and 3 bosses!

100% NO AI GUARANTEED!!

No procedurally generated content.
description_short: Law of Demons is a dark medieval action-adventure, brought to life with the twisted art and uncanny vision of Sierra Tunis. Traverse the surreal and violent world of Spire and face off against the diabolical foes which stand in your way. Do you have what it takes to fight the law?
